full_judgment: 2. Plaintiff-respondent No. 1 instituted the suit for declaration of title to 32 a decimals of land appertaining to 13 decimals of plot No. 19452, 13 decimals from plot No. 19368 and 06 1/2 decimals from plot No. 19397 of Mouza Taraf-Umedpur Plaintiffs case in short is that one Ketabdi Monde being the owner in possession settled the suit land with the plaintiffs mother, Orenja Nessa, on 14 Falgun, 1341 B.S. corresponding to 26.2.35 A.D. by a registered patta (Ext. 1) and since then the plaintiffs mother had been possessing the same. After her death the plaintiff inherited the same and has been in possession therein, Defendant No. 1 has been possessing the remaining portion of plot Nos. 19768. 19397. But the suit property has wrongly been recorded in S.A. Khatian No. 868 in the name of the defendants.
